assign.outcome:
**No Cloudflare Worker has ever shipped.** Every `wrangler.jsonc`/`wrangler.toml` across all three projects (`frozen-helix`, `lew42com`, this repo) declares `assets` only — no `main` key, ever, in any commit read. [**Prior Cloudflare**](/imagine/platform/prior/) has the full picture: what each project built (frozen-helix's unbuilt D1/DO/R2/KV `Saver` design, lew42com's Server-naming churn with zero real CF mentions, this repo's trailing-slash hybrid + a full [CMS think-through](/imagine/cms/thinking/) + a [mock services UI](/imagine/cms/services/) + a fully-cited [Durable Object design](/imagine/stream/doc/durable-objects.md)); five written verdicts each linked to its doc; reuse/do-not-copy calls, one line each.

**Two-count grep** (`durable object|workers|D1|KV|R2|queues|wrangler`, 3 projects): raw 45 code-file / 40 doc-file hits — read by hand and filtered to **13 real code / 25 real doc** mentions. Most raw noise is minified vendor JS, this repo's own `R1`..`R11` proposal-numbering convention, the verb "queues", and "workers" meaning Claude agent minions, not Cloudflare Workers.

**Left undone:** the mastermind still adds `prior` to `/imagine/platform/page.js`'s `children:` — the brief forbade editing that file, so the page is reachable today only by direct url or this task's own links.
